d: It’s boom times for digital readers! There are E Ink and E Ink-like devices all over the place, from Kindles to Kobos to Booxes to Xteinks. Jackie Robicheaux, who you might know on social media as Jackie’s Book Tally, joins the show to talk through her thoughts on all the new devices — which ones are too big, too small, too warm, too cold, and just right.
